execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"
CREATE TYPE "public"."booking_status" AS ENUM ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED', 'EXPIRED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."payment_method" AS ENUM ('QRIS', 'BANK_TRANSFER', 'E_WALLET', 'CREDIT_CARD', 'VA', 'CASH')
CREATE TYPE "public"."payment_provider" AS ENUM ('MIDTRANS', 'XENDIT', 'MANUAL')
CREATE TYPE "public"."payment_status" AS ENUM ('UNPAID', 'PAID', 'FAILED', 'REFUNDED', 'EXPIRED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."role" AS ENUM ('ADMIN', 'USER')
CREATE TYPE "public"."transaction_status" AS ENUM ('PENDING', 'SETTLEMENT', 'EXPIRE', 'CANCEL', 'DENY')

CREATE TABLE "public"."booking_time_slots" (
  "booking_date" date NOT NULL,
  "booking_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "end_time" time NOT NULL,
  "field_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "price" int4 NOT NULL,
  "start_time" time NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "booking_time_slots_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bookings" (
  "booking_date" date NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "duration_hours" int4 NOT NULL,
  "field_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "payment_status" "payment_status" DEFAULT 'UNPAID'::"payment_status" NOT NULL,
  "status" "booking_status" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"booking_status" NOT NULL,
  "total_price" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "bookings_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."field_images" (
  "created_at" timestamp DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "field_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "field_images_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."field_operating_hours" (
  "close_time" time NOT NULL,
  "day_of_week" int4 NOT NULL,
  "field_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "open_time" time NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "field_operating_hours_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."fields" (
  "capacity" int4,
  "created_at" timestamp DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "location" text,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "price_per_hour" int4 NOT NULL,
  "slug" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "type" character varying(50),
  "updated_at" timestamp DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "fields_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."transactions" (
  "booking_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expired_at" timestamp,
  "gross_amount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "order_id" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "paid_at" timestamp,
  "payment_method" "payment_method",
  "payment_url" text,
  "provider" "payment_provider" NOT NULL,
  "snap_token" text,
  "transaction_status" "transaction_status" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"transaction_status" NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "transactions_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamp DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" character varying(20),
  "role" "role" DEFAULT 'USER'::"role" NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "users_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
